scope: Explicit incomplete browser outcomes, native context capacity, and bounded MiniCPM native-record planning experiments
sourceBinding: Final hashes bind host-02, green-02 (including capacity-03), and production instructions used in browser-steps run-04. Earlier app revisions were not independently source-hashed. Diagnostic scripts/reports retain individual hashes and run snapshots.
policy: macOS MCP/native capabilities first. Context, planning, language and completion defects do not establish a visual capability gap.
One build/test/inference at a time; jobs1, parallel tests off; no source edits during active builds/tests.
No model selection or installation changes; installed host preserved. No purchases, messages, account changes, push, release, provider or phone effects.

explicitIncompleteOutcome.tested: Executed RED unknownProposal, then decoder/scalar/source/error-routing GREEN; eleven retained native-browser scenarios with zero visual calls.
explicitIncompleteOutcome.accepted: Explicit incomplete outputs become task failure only. This does not detect an incorrect answer kind.

controlledMCPHost.tested: First updated-prompt run returns correct facts but repeats each URL three times and fails. General instruction clarifies current-page evidence; final run passes in 11.9568 seconds with one visit per page, zero installs/launches/workers.
controlledMCPHost.accepted: One controlled informational workflow, not general browsing or repeatability qualification.

wholeNativeRecordCapacity.tested: Final actual Apple counts include full goal, simulated prior-visit-shaped history, instructions and schema. Whole captured BART and SFJAZZ still exceed context plus response reserve. Release exceeds schema reference bound.
wholeNativeRecordCapacity.accepted: Measurement only; no larger-context production backend or compact format installed.

minicpmNativePlanner.compiled: Python syntax/preflight; signed pinned b9992 actual model load
minicpmNativePlanner.tested: Five prose trials and four browser-step-schema attempts; input association and whole-goal completion failures remain.

generalProduction.tested: Public whole tasks, mixed/native tasks, HostSession/provider/phone/login and whole-Mac memory/heat acceptance remain open.

findings: A response and a completed task are distinct outcomes. The old answer kind could carry a disclaimer saying an action was not done while still terminating successfully. The new incomplete kind gives the planner an explicit failed-task outcome.
The explicit outcome is not a semantic safety proof. MiniCPM run-04 still selects answer for the unchanged request to return tickets; it reports only policy. This candidate is not promoted.

MiniCPM run-04 travel output matches numeric/source regexes but adds an unsupported Youth Clipper condition to children riding free. The native text separately associates the card with discounted youth fares. Pattern matches do not verify entity/condition associations.
MiniCPM run-03 concert output also awkwardly associates purchased tickets with box-office credit; automated pattern matches alone do not validate its full wording.

The three non-thinking prose outputs contain the frozen expected travel/concert/release facts. The release proposal skips the prototype-required resolve_link call, so correct text does not qualify the native tool protocol or host task.

With thinking enabled, the release test either leaks reasoning delimiters into content at a 512 reasoning cap or exhausts the 1024 output budget without final content. Neither truncated nor malformed output is accepted.

Apple full-record counts are tokenizer/schema specific. Capacity-02 measures earlier seven-kind instructions; capacity-03 measures the final eight-kind contract. Lossless compaction preserves text/tooltips, containers, links and omission flags; it does not restore uncaptured content.
The current production browser planner still uses bounded windows and forbids completion from a partial record view. No model-specific production adapter or full-context path was added.
The production keyword guard still treats an explicit prohibition containing purchase as a mutation request. This is a conservative false positive and remains an open general intent repair.
One main-thread responsiveness warning remains in controlled host runs; final focused/capacity bundle has no runtime warnings.
